task.title: Step 07: DOC-UPDATER — changelog, reqctl status, retro, GitHub branch management
task.description: Final workflow step. The DOC-UPDATER is responsible for: (1) adding an entry to CHANGELOG.md describing the ISS-0706 / GH-791 fix; (2) transitioning requirement statuses via `python tools/reqctl.py` (if any requirements are tracked for this issue); (3) running the workflow retrospective; (4) managing the GitHub feature branch to completion: PR if not already, squash-merge to main, branch cleanup, project board update, close GH-791 with a comment referencing the merged commit, and return to clean main. This is the FINAL step in the WF-03 pipeline before Step Final (BACKEND-DEV git-merge).
